pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped dark brown polygonal regions with moderately sharp pixel-gradient edges. Patch size is maximum along the mid-flank and upper neck, showing a significant reduction in relative spatial area towards the ventral region and posterior haunch.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light tan pathways forming a topological graph. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-flank region before narrowing near the lower extremities.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck line, transitioning to a smoother, lower-profile contour over the shoulder hump.
